routines.name: draw_score_value
routines.purpose: Render packed-BCD scores right-aligned within the caller-provided digit span using B as the HUD color, blanking leading zeroes, preserving internal zeroes, showing an all-zero value as one zero, and restoring the caller's PAR5 mapping before return.
routines.inputs: B selects the digit palette; X points to three packed-BCD bytes; Y points to a six-digit field.
routines.outputs: Draws the six-digit value with leading zeroes blanked, advances X by three bytes and Y by six tiles, preserves U, and restores PAR5.
routines.clobbers: A, B, condition codes, PRES_TMP_H/PRES_TMP_M/PRES_TMP_L, and HUD_COLOR; X and Y advance as specified.
routines.reads: Three packed-BCD bytes through X and the selected palette in B.
routines.writes: The destination field through PRES_MAIN_SHARED_MASK or PRES_MAIN_DYNAMIC_TEXT, plus the declared scratch bytes.
routines.invariants: Internal zeroes use numeric glyphs; leading cells are blanked while preserving the caller-provided field width; an all-zero value leaves one visible zero.

routines.name: draw_score_value_short
routines.purpose: Render two packed-BCD bytes through the shared score painter using B as the HUD color, blanking leading zeroes and restoring the caller's PAR5 mapping before return.
routines.inputs: B selects the digit palette; X points to two packed-BCD bytes; Y points to a four-digit field.
routines.outputs: Draws the four-digit value with leading zeroes blanked, advances X by two bytes and Y by four tiles, and restores PAR5.
routines.clobbers: A, B, condition codes, PRES_TMP_H/PRES_TMP_M/PRES_TMP_L, and HUD_COLOR; X and Y advance as specified. U is preserved.
routines.reads: Two packed-BCD bytes through X and the selected palette in B.
routines.writes: The destination field through PRES_MAIN_SHARED_MASK or PRES_MAIN_DYNAMIC_TEXT, plus the declared scratch bytes.
routines.invariants: Uses the same digit-formatting routine as six-digit scores; requires a four-cell destination and valid packed BCD.

routines.name: draw_score_value_digit
routines.purpose: Render one score digit in HUD_COLOR or a blank leading cell, set the significance flag when the first nonzero digit is encountered, and advance Y by one tile.
routines.inputs: A contains one unpacked decimal digit from 0 to 9; Y points to the next score tile; HUD_COLOR selects the digit palette; PRES_TMP_M records whether a significant digit has started.
routines.outputs: Draws one digit or blank tile, advances Y by 4 bytes, and sets PRES_TMP_M when the first nonzero digit is reached.
routines.clobbers: A, B, U, and condition codes; X is preserved; Y advances by 4 bytes.
routines.reads: A, HUD_COLOR, PRES_TMP_M, and the current tile-render context.
routines.writes: PRES_TMP_M when significance starts and the destination tile through PRES_MAIN_SHARED_MASK or PRES_MAIN_DYNAMIC_TEXT.
routines.side_effects: Draws one score tile and advances the score destination to the next tile.
routines.invariants: Leading zeroes before the first nonzero digit use the blank tile; later zeroes use the numeric glyph; HUD_COLOR selects the numeric glyph color; A must be from 0 to 9.

routines.name: logo_vbord_clock
routines.purpose: Advance the shared attract and high-score logo phase from an IRQ-atomic VBLANK sample.
routines.inputs: FRAMES, PRES_SCREEN, the reserved three-byte clock at $A8FD-$A8FF, and the caller's PAR4 mapping.
routines.outputs: A 0/1 logo phase; the clock advances once per complete 31-frame interval and is reinitialized when the screen token changes.
routines.clobbers: A, B, D, U, X; condition codes and PAR4 are restored.
routines.reads: IRQ-owned u16 FRAMES at $0002, PRES_SCREEN, the caller's PAR4, and clock state through PAR4 page $34.
routines.writes: The reserved clock state through PAR4 page $34 and phase-exclusive D2/E3 logo-owner cache invalidation on a screen change. D3 actor phase is untouched.
routines.side_effects: Masks IRQ while sampling FRAMES; temporarily maps PAR4 to page $34 and restores it before return.
routines.invariants: Never writes PRES_TIMER; restores caller PAR4 and CC; uses only the reserved $A8FD-$A8FF state and existing helper owner.

root.inputs: Entry-specific machine state and the shared direct-page protocol named by the routine purpose
root.outputs: Control transfers or status values defined by the routine purpose
root.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless the caller-facing entry contract states otherwise
root.reads: Always-mapped direct-page protocol state plus the module-owned state required by the selected operation
root.writes: Module-owned state and mapped hardware registers required to establish or dispatch the operation
root.side_effects: May change mapping, interrupt, rendering, or lifecycle ownership as stated by the routine purpose
root.invariants: The stack remains balanced and every temporary PAR mapping is restored or deliberately handed off before return

state.inputs: Current authoritative gameplay or presentation state; register arguments are named by the routine label and immediate caller
state.outputs: Updated authoritative state and condition codes used by the immediate caller
state.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
state.reads: Owned direct-page and page-$34 state needed for the operation
state.writes: Only the owned state fields and render intents required by the operation
state.side_effects: May enqueue rendering work but does not publish FRONT
state.invariants: Authoritative state changes precede their render intents; framebuffer publication remains IRQ-owned

render.inputs: Current render intent, selected actor or tile state, and a valid BACK or staging destination
render.outputs: Updated destination pixels and any owner-local history required by later restoration
render.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
render.reads: Authoritative gameplay state, immutable art streams, and current owner-local background metadata
render.writes: BACK or staging pixels, render scratch, and owner-local save-under or damage metadata
render.side_effects: Changes a non-visible composition surface or its metadata
render.invariants: The routine never selects the visible FRONT surface; temporary PAR5 mappings expire or restore before return

framebuffer.inputs: ACTIVE/PENDING state, BACK identity, owner metadata, and the current worklist
framebuffer.outputs: A prepared, captured, finished, or published framebuffer transaction as named by the routine
framebuffer.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless the fixed entry contract narrows them
framebuffer.reads: Always-mapped framebuffer protocol bytes and owner-local metadata
framebuffer.writes: Framebuffer protocol bytes, BACK pixels, owner-local metadata, and GIME display offset only at IRQ publication
framebuffer.side_effects: Advances one bounded phase of the persistent A/B transaction
framebuffer.invariants: Foreground code may arm PENDING but only Vbord IRQ publishes FRONT; mapping-sensitive pointers do not outlive PAR changes

movement.inputs: Current actor coordinates, direction, maze topology, gate state, and collision state
movement.outputs: A legality result, selected direction, contact result, or updated actor state
movement.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
movement.reads: Authoritative actor records, maze and gate tables, and movement scratch
movement.writes: Owned actor state, collision flags, and render intents required by the movement result
movement.side_effects: May change authoritative gameplay state and queue later composition
movement.invariants: Movement remains on legal semantic cells and does not write framebuffer pixels directly

copy.inputs: Source and destination identities, bounded count or stream metadata, and any required mapped page
copy.outputs: Copied, decoded, merged, cached, or addressed data plus caller-visible pointer progress
copy.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
copy.reads: The declared source stream, table, framebuffer rows, or metadata record
copy.writes: Only the declared bounded destination record, cache, row range, or scratch fields
copy.side_effects: May temporarily map a required GIME page while moving or decoding data
copy.invariants: Counts and destination bounds are honored; any temporary GIME mapping is restored before returning unless the routine contract explicitly states otherwise

presentation.inputs: Presentation state, interval timer, input edges, current map, and the selected auxiliary profile
presentation.outputs: Updated presentation state and the dispatcher retain/release status when applicable
presentation.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
presentation.reads: Presentation direct-page state, cold payloads, authored map streams, and input state
presentation.writes: Presentation state, mapped BACK pixels, and presentation-owned persistent metadata
presentation.side_effects: May retain the foreground interval or produce a complete presentation surface
presentation.invariants: Gameplay simulation begins only after release; hidden hydration may prepare initial-stage state and hold it unchanged until release; FRONT publication remains IRQ-owned

input.inputs: PIA input state, prior sampled state, and axis or key selection
input.outputs: Normalized input state, edge bits, or axis sample
input.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
input.reads: PIA registers and prior input samples
input.writes: Owned input state and temporary PIA scan selection
input.side_effects: Temporarily drives keyboard or joystick scan hardware
input.invariants: PIA control and drive state are restored to the runtime convention before return

boot.inputs: The declared cartridge bank, staged payload, destination identity, and bootstrap mapping state
boot.outputs: Installed runtime bytes or a non-returning transfer to the next boot phase
boot.clobbers: All CPU registers and condition codes
boot.reads: Cartridge-staged payloads, generated size symbols, and bootstrap tables
boot.writes: Declared RAM destinations, PAR registers, boot scratch, and decompressed surfaces
boot.side_effects: Changes MMU mappings and copies or synthesizes executable/data payloads
boot.invariants: Authored, staged, and destination byte identities remain distinct and every transfer obeys its generated size bound

audio.inputs: Cue IDs, slot state and foreground phase; detailed register arguments remain at the source call site
audio.outputs: Updated audio queue, voice selection, status or PSG output as named by the routine
audio.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U and condition codes unless source saves a narrower set
audio.reads: Audio direct-page bytes, page-$3D cue streams and slots, and polled gameplay/name state
audio.writes: Audio-owned queue, scratch, slots, mix shadows and sound/interface registers as required by the operation
audio.side_effects: May select GMC sound output and write PSG registers; foreground callers own the bank-restoring gateway
audio.invariants: Audio-owned scratch is not game scratch; non-audio caller returns through the guarded bank-restoring gateway

keybindings.inputs: Physical CoCo switch columns, session bindings, capture state and prepared menu BACK; B selects scan, paint, menu tick or reset.
keybindings.outputs: Five held gameplay actions, fresh fixed menu edges, retained bindings or selected menu pixels; menu tick returns B=$FF to retain or B=6 to return.
keybindings.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U and condition codes except source-preserved registers; every stack return is balanced.
keybindings.reads: PIA keyboard rows, current screen ID from the generated presentation map, retired-boot-area bindings/capture state, immutable font masks and authored key-name/menu records.
keybindings.writes: Unbanked low RAM $0287-$029A and menu-owned edge/selection/dirty bytes; prepared BACK pixels and module-local owner selection cache.
keybindings.side_effects: Capture suppresses global and local consumers through accepted-key release; painting calls the resident mask renderer without changing PAR5.
keybindings.invariants: The existing page-$3D stream owns code/data at $BA00; caller gateway restores its PAR5; bindings reset at startup and never persist to storage.

movement-step.inputs: TEST_X/Y origin coordinates and cardinal TEST_DIR
movement-step.outputs: TEST_X/Y advanced by one cell along TEST_DIR
movement-step.clobbers: B and condition codes; A, X, Y, and U are preserved
movement-step.reads: TEST_DIR and the current TEST_X/Y scratch coordinates
movement-step.writes: Only the selected TEST_X or TEST_Y probe coordinate
movement-step.side_effects: Advances the probe coordinate without reading maze, gate, actor, or rendering state
movement-step.invariants: Exactly one cardinal coordinate changes by one cell; authoritative actor coordinates, gate state, and rendering remain untouched

movement-admission.inputs: TEST_X/Y origin coordinates, cardinal TEST_DIR, maze navigation and gate tables, and current GATE_STATE
movement-admission.outputs: C set on admission; A=0 for ordinary or no-action admission, or A=1..4 for a deferred gate-state action; B is the animation style only when A is nonzero
movement-admission.clobbers: A, B, D, X, and condition codes; TEST_X/Y and GATE_ID/X/Y are probe scratch
movement-admission.reads: TEST_DIR, TEST_X/Y, maze_nav, maze_gate_owner, maze_gates, and GATE_STATE
movement-admission.writes: TEST_X/Y and GATE_ID/X/Y probe scratch only; never GATE_STATE, GATE_ANIM_STYLE, GATE_ANIM_ID, GATE_COMPOSE_MODE, actor records, or render surfaces
movement-admission.side_effects: Classifies a move and any endpoint rotation action without committing a gate or queueing a redraw
movement-admission.invariants: A=0 means ordinary/no-action admission; A=1..4 encodes new gate state A-1 and B carries the requested style; authoritative world and visible rendering remain unchanged
